[CRITICAL] LOGIC <Duplicate method definition causing compilation failure> (class LRUCache, method _evict_oldest)
- Issue: Adding a second _evict_oldest method creates a duplicate definition, causing a syntax error that prevents the module from loading; any call to put will raise an exception before eviction occurs, breaking cache semantics.
- Fix: Remove the duplicated _evict_oldest method definition.

[WARNING] STRUCTURE <Unused duplicated method> (class LRUCache, method _evict_oldest)
- Issue: The added _evict_oldest method is never invoked, so its presence adds unnecessary code that will require maintenance and may mislead readers; future changes to eviction logic must be applied in two places.
- Fix: Delete the duplicated method and ensure _evict_oldest is called only from put while holding the lock.
NO_ISSUES_FOUND: Correct, safe, well-structured, and no simpler version is worth the change.
